description: Sturmwurfgefährdung aggregiert is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. This aggregated dataset provides a combined view of the exposure and probability of tree crashes to the rail infrastructure in NRW and Thuringia to tree fall. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Storm throw hazard aggregated" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inspireidentifiziert, opendata. The listing shows 2023-07-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
